summary: performance lens over NATIVE-FOREGROUND-ACTIVATE (25 product path(s), 7a462bc..c21b80b, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 0 blocking, 2 non-blocking. The change introduces two concrete performance regressions on operational hot paths: every native write reparses an ever-growing ledger twice, and native completion repeatedly reads and deserializes the full runtime transcript. Both costs scale with durable history or run length and are already exercised with multi-megabyte evidence.

non_blocking_findings.summary: [P2] Avoid reparsing the append-only delegation ledger for every native write (factory/scripts/forge_cli/worker_admission.py:185): On every locked native Edit/Write/apply_patch hook, `live_worker_admission` parses the entire protected delegation ledger here even though `all_rows` is only needed when `FORGE_LAUNCH_ID` is absent.

[P2] Do not materialize and repeatedly parse the complete native JSONL log (factory/scripts/forge_cli/delegate.py:1306): The native completion path reads the entire stdout JSONL into `stdout` here but never uses that string for the Codex route.
